channel.title: VND on ZooBerry
channel.description: Recent content in VND on ZooBerry

item.title: Palette Edits: Pacific Giant Octopus
item.description: A small mod that edits the palette and various related graphics for the Pacific giant octopus, changing its default yellow palette to a red palette resembling the real animal.

item.title: Sea Otter Patch
item.description: A mod that edits the palette and various related graphics for the Southern sea otter to resemble the real animal, with two approaches to continue using the original brown palette.

item.title: Palette Edits: Grizzly Bear
item.description: A small mod that edits the palette and various related graphics for the grizzly bear, removing the yellow-green hue of the original for a more natural look.

item.title: Bluefin Tuna Patch
item.description: A mod that edits the palette and various related graphics to turn the bluefin tuna into the skipjack tuna, either as a replacement patch or a standalone animal.

item.title: Palette Edits & Dimorphism Hack: American Bison
item.description: A mod that removes the hay-like colour scheme of the American (plains) bison for more naturalistic looks.

item.title: Underwater Thermals Hack
item.description: Make various Dinosaur Digs steam vents, geysers, and volcanoes tank placeable and reduce their footprint.

item.title: Jaguar Remake II
item.description: This mod is a fan update and extension of the original Jaguar Remake project by Mayer and Ludozoo.
